name: self-check
description: Lets a session check that its own tools answer: a nonce echoed through the Bash and PowerShell tools as the model calls them, each within 10 seconds, how much room the session env leaves a Bash command on Windows, and the MCP servers listed (exercised only through probes you name). Quietly again when the session is resumed, saying only what failed. Dedupes Bash's session env after each session start, against Git Bash's 8,186-character cut.

updateCheck.title: Update check
updateCheck.description: on: when a tool of this plugin is called and the last check is 30 minutes old, fetch this plugin's published plugin.json from GitHub (a plain GET of a public file) and say when a newer version is out. off: never check.

checkAtResume.title: Check at resume
checkAtResume.description: on: 10 seconds after this session is resumed, once it is idle, run the same check quietly and say only what failed (a toast, and a note Claude reads with the next message). off: check only when Claude calls tools_check.

envDedupe.title: Bash env dedupe
envDedupe.description: on: after each session start (startup, resume, clear, compact), and when tools_check finds the env at risk, dedupe this session's setup and sessionstart env files (~/.claude/session-env/<session>/*-hook-<n>.sh, which Claude Code puts into every Bash call) once they total over 2 KB: each variable's last assignment is kept, so the environment is the same; a file with any other kind of line is left as it is; backups <name>.orig (once) and <name>.bak (latest). off: never rewrite them; tools_check still says how much room they leave.

probes.title: MCP probes
probes.description: MCP servers to exercise, each as server=tool: the server as its tools are named (mcp__<server>__<tool>), and one of its tools that only reads and needs no arguments. A server not named here is listed, never called.
